newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks close higher, blue chips glow.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks close higher, blue chips glow.

text.p: Most Croatian stocks closed higher on Wednesday in modest activity, with drugs firm Pliva and Zagrebacka Banka scoring new records.
* Eight of 16 issues rose, three fell and five were flat.
* Volume shrank to 15,101 from 19,817 units, turnover was more than halved at 6.3 million kuna.
* Pliva, selling 5,520 shares, was the most active issue. It rose 10 kuna to close at 571.
* Top gainer Zagrebacka Banka preferred E-series added 38 kuna or 2.53 percent to 1,540 kuna on volume of 420 units.
* The bank's ordinary stock closed flat at 2,400 on volume of 145 after peaking at a 2,447-kuna all-time high during the session.
* Biggest decliner was ship repairer Viktor Lenac, losing 11 kuna or 6.36 percent to 162 kuna with 145 shares sold.
